==Acquisition==
*Talk to [[Tyr the Skaald]] [Norn Storyteller] in [[Gunnar's Hold]] after attaining the first rank of the [[Norn rank|Norn title]].

== Notes ==
* This cannot be equipped on the [[skill bar]]. While a [[character]] displays the Norn title, this effect is applied to that character and all of their [[hero]]es.
* ''Norn territory'' is the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] region.
* Hero health remains the same in outposts whether the title is switched on or off.

==Trivia==
*The art on this [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Jora]] wearing [[Brotherhood armor]].
